turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, is this Mr. Patil from Pune? I am Inspector Vikram from the Cyber Crime Division office.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, I am Patil. What happened, sir? Why are you calling?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, we intercepted a courier package from Mumbai containing illegal narcotics and several fake passports.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Narcotics? But I have never sent any such parcel in my life!

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The problem is your Aadhaar number is listed as the primary contact for the sender. This is a very serious criminal matter.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: This must be a mistake. Please check again, I am a retired government employee.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Listen carefully, because of the sensitivity of this case, you are now under digital arrest. You must stay on this call and not tell a soul, or we will have to come and pick you up.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Digital arrest? I don't understand. Can I call my son to help me?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Absolutely not. If you leak this information, it will be treated as obstructing a government investigation.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I am very scared now. Please tell me how to clear my name.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: To verify your innocence and clear your Aadhaar from the blacklist, you must deposit fifty thousand rupees into our secure government verification account.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Fifty thousand? I don't have that much ready in my hand right now.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You have one hour to transfer the amount, otherwise the local Pune police will arrive at your door with handcuffs.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Please give me some time, I will try to arrange it.
